purpose: Freeze admissible source-materialisation paths before extracting any government issuance series. The BNR domestic-primary-market series and Ministry all-market borrowing series must remain separate because they answer different questions.

bnr_domestic_primary_market.source_family: Monthly Bulletin table 12.2 Government securities (new and roll-over issues)
required_fields: EUR-denominated treasury-certificate nominal amount when present
EUR-denominated government-bond nominal amount when present
bnr_domestic_primary_market.retained_currency_rule: Retain native published currency columns separately. Do not convert EUR issue volumes to RON unless a separately frozen exchange-rate convention is preregistered.
bnr_domestic_primary_market.aggregation_rule: A RON domestic-primary-market total may sum only RON-denominated treasury certificates and RON-denominated allotted government bonds. EUR amounts remain separate.
bnr_domestic_primary_market.historical_coverage_gate: Require a contiguous retained monthly source vintage with explicit table semantics before promotion to an observed reference series.
prohibited_shortcuts: do not add retail securities unless the BNR table explicitly includes them on the same boundary
do not add Eurobonds or loans
do not infer refinancing need from gross primary-market issuance
do not call the resulting series securities supply pressure
do not convert a new-and-roll-over issue series into net incurrence
bnr_domestic_primary_market.revision_check_source: BNR Monthly Bulletin — December 2025, statistical data available as of 2026-02-24
remaining_promotion_gates: materialise instrument- and currency-specific primary-market yield/rate observations descriptively without scalar aggregation
preregister and validate financing-channel allocation before linking government financing need to the BNR issuance boundary
operationalise and validate securities supply pressure rather than relabelling raw issuance volume
freeze exact primary-yield to sovereign-yield boundary or ex-ante aggregation rule
specify maturity/refinancing/re-fixing propagation from new-issue yields to outstanding-debt interest cost

mof_actual_borrowing.source_family: Monthly public-debt report — Actual borrowings by instrument/currency/market
mof_actual_borrowing.materialisation_rule: Retain the cumulative year-to-date values exactly as published before considering monthly increments.
monthly_increment_gate: current and previous reports must use the same instrument definitions
currency-conversion conventions must be identical or native-currency values must be available
exchange operations included in Treasury-bond lines must be identified
month-to-month differencing may be executed only after all above gates pass
mof_actual_borrowing.securities_subset_rule: A securities-only series may include only explicitly identified securities instruments. Loans and RRF/PNRR drawings remain separate.
prohibited_shortcuts: do not difference cumulative RON values across reports with changed FX conversion conventions
do not treat total reimbursable financing as securities issuance
do not mix local-government borrowing into MoF central-government borrowing
do not merge cash-management certificates silently into longer-term issuance
do not infer the BNR domestic-primary-market series by subtraction

cross_source_rule.reason: BNR and Ministry reports use different market/instrument/reporting boundaries; discrepancies must be explained by boundary mapping before any reconciliation test.
cross_source_rule.possible_future_use: Use BNR for a narrowly defined domestic primary-market issuance observable and Ministry reports for broader realized financing/borrowing composition.
